bookingOpens: Online only, through the booking page on the restaurant's own website (thechairmangroup.com). Tables are released a quarter at a time: bookings for January to March 2027 open on 5 November 2026 at 9am Hong Kong time, and October to December 2026 is already full. A few days before the meal the restaurant sends the set menus by email, and the table chooses its dishes in advance; this applies at lunch and dinner.

bookingWindow.note: Tables are released one quarter at a time on a date announced on the booking page: January to March 2027 opens on 5 November 2026 at 9am.

waitlist: There is no waiting list: tables freed by cancellations reappear in the online booking system automatically.
